fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/marten-creek-campground (Fee Site and Info 'No fees are required for this site', '$0.00 Pack in/Pack out'; page last updated May 1, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 6 developed sites, 4 with shelters (15 people per camping shelter). One site takes a group of up to 45; the larger shelter is a pavilion with 3 tables.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/marten-creek-campground ('The campground has 6 developed sites (4 with shelters) tables and fire rings, and able to accommodate up to a 32' RV. One of these sites is able to accommodate a group of up to 45 people'; 'Max size or group: 15 people per camping shelter/45 people day use shelter'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Pack in, pack out. Gravel roads, developed boat launch and dock.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/marten-creek-campground ('Amenities include vault toilets, gravel roads throughout, developed boat launch and dock.'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'Please practice Pack-in-Pack-out'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF (Cabinet RD) campground at Marten Creek Bay on Noxon Reservoir, ~9 mi north of Trout Creek via Marten Creek Rd 2229. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 1, 2026) confirms free camping, 6 sites (4 with shelters, one group-capable), 32-ft RV max, vault toilets, no potable water, boat launch and dock. Not stated: reservations/FCFS, season, stay limit (derived 14 nights left; the page only points to the regional stay-limit order). Not on recreation.gov. No Kootenai NF alert or flood washout listed for Marten Creek Rd. Note trimmed of restated sites, length, facilities, fee and stay limit.
